propositions: A Jira issue's KEY changes when moved between projects, but its numeric ID remains immutable; bindings keyed on KEY silently detach when the old key stops resolving due to failed moved_issue_key table updates.
The binding store must record the numeric jira_id alongside the key and resolve by ID on key lookup failure, re-keying the binding to the issue's current key if a hit is found.
The fix is additive to avoid rewriting shared Cloud-facing identity semantics and the reverse index; legacy bindings without recorded IDs degrade safely with no migration required.

When a key lookup 404s, retry by the recorded numeric ID; if that resolves with a different key, update the binding's key and reverse index atomically, reset the absence counter, and emit a binding-rekeyed alert.

On DC 8.17.1, GET /rest/api/2/issue/{oldKey} after a project key rename returns 200 with the new key in the body, so the old key resolves transparently through moved_issue_key when that table is intact.
